name: - FPR
fix_description: In setAdmin (0x704b6c02), there is no msg.sender check. Anyone can overwrite storage[0x00] (admin address). Add require(msg.sender == currentAdmin) before updating.
difficulty_reasoning: The exploit is a very straightforward access-control failure: the attacker simply calls setAdmin on vulnerable contracts, drains assets via remaining, and swaps/removes liquidity for profit. It requires minimal protocol-specific reasoning, no flash loans or complex state manipulation, and the PoC is short with only a few direct external calls.
